description: Diagram must begin with 'bpmn-beta' as the first non-comment, non-empty line
correction: Add 'bpmn-beta' as the first line of the diagram

description: All flow source IDs must reference a declared element
check: every flow.source exists in declared element IDs
correction: Declare the missing element before any flow that references it

description: All flow target IDs must reference a declared element
check: every flow.target exists in declared element IDs
correction: Declare the missing element before any flow that references it

description: XOR gateways must have at least two outgoing flows
correction: Add a second outgoing flow from the XOR gateway with a condition label

description: XOR gateway outgoing flows must each have a condition label
check: all flows where source = xor.id have a label
correction: Add a condition label after the colon: 'g1 --> t2: "condition"'

description: AND (parallel) split gateway should have a corresponding AND join gateway
check: for each and-split, there exists an and-join that merges its branches (unless branches terminate in separate end events)
correction: Add a parallel AND gateway to rejoin the split branches, or route each branch to a separate end event

description: Every declared element must appear in at least one flow (no orphans)
check: every element.id appears in at least one flow as source or target
correction: Connect the orphan element to the process flow with a --> declaration

description: Pool blocks must not be nested inside other pool blocks
check: no pool declaration appears inside an open pool context
correction: Close the outer pool block with } before declaring the next pool

description: Lane blocks must be declared inside a pool block
check: every lane declaration appears inside an open pool context
correction: Wrap the lane declaration inside a pool { ... } block

description: Lane blocks must not be nested inside other lane blocks
check: no lane declaration appears inside an open lane context
correction: Close the outer lane block with } before declaring the next lane

description: Message flows (~~>) must be declared at the top level, not inside pool or lane blocks
check: all ~~> flows appear at the top level (context stack is empty)
correction: Move the ~~> flow declaration outside all pool and lane blocks

description: All string labels must be enclosed in double quotes
check: every label is a double-quoted string
correction: Wrap the label in double quotes: "My Label"

description: Element IDs must not use reserved keywords
check: no element ID is a reserved keyword
correction: Rename the ID to something non-reserved (e.g., 'andGate' instead of 'and')

description: Element IDs must not contain hyphens
check: no ID contains a hyphen character
correction: Replace hyphens with underscores or camelCase: 'my_task' or 'myTask'

description: Element IDs must begin with a letter
correction: Prefix numeric-only IDs with a letter: '1' becomes 't1'

check: every } has a corresponding open pool or lane block
correction: Remove the extra } or add the missing opening pool/lane block

description: Do not use event:message, event:timer, or event:error keywords (not parsed in v0.1)
correction: Use task:receive, task:service, or end with a descriptive label instead. See known-limitations.md.

description: Do not use the association operator --- (not yet parsed in v0.1)
check: no line contains the '---' operator in a flow context
correction: Remove the association or use a comment (%%) to annotate the intended relationship
